title: ENS Expiration Alert
tagline: Project Not Completed and Not Working. Service that notifies when user's ENS domains expire.
description:
Project not done and not complete.

Calendar reminders created on the ENS site are insufficient. For instance, it doesn't detect domains registered after the invite is created. This service, upon entering wallet address, would have detected ENS registration changes and sent Telegram and/or email reminders to user.
